sir-halden-rook.habit: checks his reflection in his blade

minstrel-rilo.hope: be hired by Dame Orla for a full season
minstrel-rilo.hook: Heard sailors say Nedda's barge 'rides light and smells bright'.
minstrel-rilo.tie: Sometimes rooms with Nessa; carries news.

pilgrim-asha.habit: washes her feet before every gate
pilgrim-asha.object: walking staff carved with mercy marks
pilgrim-asha.fear: faithful folk turned away for being poor
pilgrim-asha.hook: Was offered 'safe passage' papers by Pale Orin for a 'donation'.
pilgrim-asha.tie: Guest of Elen's temple; rejected Orin.

sailor-tem.habit: reads water the way scholars read books
sailor-tem.fear: fog collisions near the mill race
sailor-tem.hope: captain his own flatboat next year
sailor-tem.hook: Refused to tow Nedda after smelling her 'grain'.
sailor-tem.tie: Works docks with Mael; cleaner than Nedda.

hunter-vessa.place: cold camps beyond the tree line
hunter-vessa.habit: shares meat before she shares names
hunter-vessa.hope: sell honest furs without guild bribes
hunter-vessa.hook: Tracked armed strangers caching rope near the mill at dusk.
hunter-vessa.tie: Friends with Skog; confirms Kavi's trail signs.

courier-blink.place: the long road in all weather
courier-blink.habit: never sleeps in the same loft twice
courier-blink.object: sealable message tube worn as a belt
courier-blink.fear: being forced to open a letter
courier-blink.hope: hire Finn as a second when the boy is ready
courier-blink.hook: Carried a sealed note from Kitty Shade to someone inside Vale Manor.

smith-dara.habit: tests steel with a thumbnail and a prayer
smith-dara.hope: forge a gate hinge that outlasts gossip
smith-dara.hook: Told Ulf a returned spear wasn't hers—and stamped a covert mark on new watch blades.
smith-dara.tie: Ally to Serra; supplier to Ulf.

cooper-brenwick.habit: rolls barrels to hear their honesty
cooper-brenwick.fear: taverns switching to cheap imported casks
cooper-brenwick.hope: keep Mira and Bren stocked through festival season
cooper-brenwick.hook: Built a 'special' barrel with a sleeve cavity on a rush order paid in mixed coin.
cooper-brenwick.tie: Supplies Mira/Bren; uneasy about the special order.

potter-umi.place: a kiln yard scented with wet clay
potter-umi.object: glaze recipes in a cipher only she enjoys
potter-umi.fear: a kiln fire jumping to thatch
potter-umi.hope: sell a dinner set to Dame Orla
potter-umi.hook: Fired a batch of plain jars that a buyer insisted be waterproof and opaque.
potter-umi.tie: Sells to Petra for ointment pots.

carpenter-jod.fear: rot in the mill beams being ignored
carpenter-jod.hope: win the contract to restore the mill safely
carpenter-jod.hook: Quoted a repair on mill joists and found fresh sawdust in a 'sealed' undercroft vent.
carpenter-jod.tie: Potential mill work; evidence for Olda's theory.

cobbler-pax.habit: guesses a customer's miles from their soles
cobbler-pax.object: lasts lined up like little soldiers
cobbler-pax.hope: shoe the whole watch at a fair rate
cobbler-pax.hook: Recognized Vale-cobbled boots on Father Bram's 'nobody' burial description.
cobbler-pax.tie: Gossip node; connects to Bram's mystery corpse.

fletcher-ira.habit: spins shafts to hear truth in the wobble
fletcher-ira.fear: her arrows used in alley murders
fletcher-ira.hope: rearm Aya's night watch with matched sets
fletcher-ira.hook: Sold a custom quiver to a buyer who paid with Rook's laundry-mark IOU.
fletcher-ira.tie: Supplies Aya; IOU ties to Rook.

baker-moll.habit: feeds anyone who sweeps her step
baker-moll.object: recipe board with flour ghosts of old menus
baker-moll.hope: keep prices fair when grain spikes
baker-moll.hook: Told Dorn when Bask threatened her—and hid a debtor's child in the flour room.
baker-moll.tie: Employer of Odin; threatened by Bask; helped by Dorn.

tinker-zib.place: a bench of gears and kettles
tinker-zib.habit: talks to broken things until they confess
tinker-zib.object: multi-tool that unfolds into too many blades
tinker-zib.fear: being blamed for traps he didn't build
tinker-zib.hook: Disarmed a tripwire near a sewer grate Mouse uses.
tinker-zib.tie: Helped Mouse unintentionally; curious about mill tech.

weaver-sala.place: a loom room loud with rhythm
weaver-sala.object: pattern book with a locked clasp
weaver-sala.hope: clothe the alms school Sister Pola dreams of
weaver-sala.hook: Was asked to weave a cloak lining that hides a rigid map sheet.
weaver-sala.tie: Rival/colleague to Hedda; kind to Pola.

stonemason-kor.habit: listens to stone for hidden cracks
stonemason-kor.hope: restore the memorial wall with Father Bram
stonemason-kor.hook: Confirmed Olda's rubbing: a filled arch exists under the mill approach.

mayor-haldrin.place: the council chamber and festival platforms
mayor-haldrin.habit: clears his throat before every compromise
mayor-haldrin.object: chain of office that pinches when he lies
mayor-haldrin.hope: leave town richer in goodwill than coin
mayor-haldrin.hook: Accepted Edric's festival funding with fewer questions than Penna liked.
mayor-haldrin.tie: Patronized by Edric; depends on Penna; peers with Sava.

clerk-penna.object: ribbon tags for 'urgent', 'political', and 'do not lose'
clerk-penna.hope: digitize nothing and perfect everything on paper
clerk-penna.hook: Flagged a warehouse writ with Pale Orin's distinctive pen pressure.
clerk-penna.tie: Essential to Mayor; threat to Orin; overflow to Hala.

bailiff-crowe.object: baton he has never raised and always shows
bailiff-crowe.hope: enforce law without starring in Kitty's rumors
bailiff-crowe.hook: Was offered a bribe to 'misplace' Rook's holding paperwork.
bailiff-crowe.tie: Works with Judge Sava; pressured by alleys.

taxer-miln.habit: apologizes and assesses in the same breath
taxer-miln.object: folding abacus and a rainproof satchel
taxer-miln.fear: being drowned in a well 'accident' of popularity
taxer-miln.hope: fund Bera's second well through honest tallies
taxer-miln.hook: Found undeclared barge income patterns matching Nedda's trips.
taxer-miln.tie: Unpopular; useful against Nedda; supports Bera.

judge-sava.habit: makes eye contact with the poorest person first
judge-sava.fear: nobles buying outcomes through festival gifts
judge-sava.hope: set a precedent that ledgers bind lords too
judge-sava.hook: Asked Merrick for a clean chain of evidence on Rook before festival court.
judge-sava.tie: Peer to Mayor; works with Crowe and Merrick.

herald-bol.object: brass bell with a cracked throat
herald-bol.fear: reading a proclamation that starts a riot
herald-bol.hope: be trusted with truth, not only volume
herald-bol.hook: Was handed two conflicting proclamations about mill ownership in one morning.
herald-bol.tie: Voice of government; confused by mill intrigue.

midwife-ora.habit: washes her hands as ritual and science
midwife-ora.object: kit bag with lavender and clean linen
midwife-ora.fear: losing a mother to pride or poverty
midwife-ora.hope: train Petra as a proper clinic partner
midwife-ora.hook: Delivered a child for a veiled woman who paid with a Vale cufflink.
midwife-ora.tie: Trusted by many; link to Petra; saw Vale jewelry.

gravedigger-mol.habit: whistles off-key to keep spirits uninterested
gravedigger-mol.fear: burying someone still claimed by the living
gravedigger-mol.hope: keep the flood memorial neat for Bram
gravedigger-mol.hook: Buried Father Bram's 'nobody' and kept the Vale-cobbled boots in a hessian sack.
gravedigger-mol.tie: Works with Bram; holds physical evidence.

ratcatcher-skit.habit: names rats before he catches them
ratcatcher-skit.object: cage of squeaks and a crooked grin
ratcatcher-skit.fear: plague talk turning into torch talk
ratcatcher-skit.hope: be paid on contract by the council, not in scraps
ratcatcher-skit.hook: Followed rat runs that revealed a chewed opening into the mill undercroft.
ratcatcher-skit.tie: Knows Mouse's world from below; evidence for undercroft.

matchmaker-bea.habit: asks about siblings before asking about love
matchmaker-bea.fear: arranging a match that hides abuse
matchmaker-bea.hope: see Pippa and Tomas dance without supervision
matchmaker-bea.hook: Noticed Lysa buying travel clothes 'for a cousin' who does not exist.
matchmaker-bea.tie: Gossips with Issy; ships Pippa/Tomas; spotted Lysa's exit plan.
